shiftLock.slot: Under air filter housing — short rod on transmission module with two flat sides
steps: Turn ignition to ON.
UNUSUAL LOCATION: The shift interlock on R50/R52/R53 MINI is accessed under the air filter housing in the engine bay.
There is a short rod on the transmission module with two flat-blade slots.
Using a flat screwdriver, rotate one slot 90 degrees to release the shift lock.
With lock released, press brake and move selector to N.
NOTE: This is the factory method — no console slot exists on this generation.
Apply parking brake.
Battery under hood — driver side.
Connect jump pack.
Restore power. Manual shift to N, or use the rod method above.
AUTOMATIC: do NOT flat-tow. Lift front wheels only.

tow.method: LIFT FRONT WHEELS (wheel-lift or flatbed). Rear wheels roll on ground. NEVER flat-tow automatic.
notes: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION: has no pump for lubrication when engine is off. Flat-towing or towing with front wheels on ground destroys transmission.
MANUAL: can flat-tow or tow any direction — select Neutral, clutch in.
Small, light vehicle — watch clearance during loading.

battery.warning: AUTOMATIC: never flat-tow. Front lift only.

alerts.warning: AUTOMATIC: NEVER flat-tow. LIFT FRONT WHEELS ONLY. Automatic transmission not equipped with oil pump when not running.
alerts.notes: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION: cannot be flat-towed under any circumstances — will destroy transmission. MANUAL: depress clutch, select N.

issues.title: Shift Lock Override Under Air Filter — NOT on Console
issues.detail: The 2002-2006 MINI Cooper (R50/R52/R53) shift lock override is NOT on the center console. It is in the ENGINE BAY under the air filter housing. There is a transmission solenoid rod with flat-blade slots — rotate one slot 90 degrees with a flathead screwdriver to release. Many operators waste time looking for a console slot that does not exist on this generation.

shiftLock.slot: Shift interlock solenoid — access via console near shifter base. Brake light switch controls system.
steps: Turn ignition to ON (do not start).
Locate shift lock override slot near shifter base — small cap or access point.
Remove cap. Insert key, press down.
Press brake pedal. Move selector to N.
Replace cap.
MANUAL: depress clutch, select N — no shift lock.
Apply parking brake.
Battery location varies: under hood or trunk depending on model.
Connect jump pack to accessible terminals.
Restore power. Use override method.
AUTOMATIC: front lift only — never flat-tow.

tow.method: AUTOMATIC: LIFT FRONT WHEELS ONLY. MANUAL: any tow method acceptable.
